records.source: The Brave Little Sapling
records.translation: Ang Matapang na Munting Punla

records.source: An animated family comedy about a little sprout on a magical adventure to become a tree!
records.translation: Isang animated na komedyang pampamilya tungkol sa munting usbong na sumasabak sa mahiwagang pakikipagsapalaran upang maging puno!

records.source: The Brave Little Sapling
records.translation: Ang Matapang na Munting Punla

records.source: The brave little sapling is leaving his home. He hesitates for a moment and turns around, knowing he won't be back for a long time...
records.translation: Aalis na sa tahanan ang munting matapang na punla. Sandali itong nag-alinlangan at lumingon, batid na matagal bago ito makabalik...

records.source: The other saplings of his grove are gathered at the edge of town, excitedly waving their twigs goodbye...!
records.translation: Nagtipon sa gilid ng bayan ang iba pang punla sa kakahuyan nito at masiglang kumakaway paalam gamit ang kanilang mga sanga...!

records.source: Oh no! Out of nowhere, it starts raining...! The little sapling goes into a sprint as thunderclouds loom overhead...
records.translation: Naku! Biglang umulan nang walang babala...! Kumaripas ng takbo ang munting punla habang nagbabanta sa itaas ang maiitim na ulap...

records.source: Fearing for his life, and demoralized by the relentless downpour, the brave little sapling begins to lose hope...
records.translation: Takot para sa sariling buhay at pinanghinaan dahil sa walang tigil na buhos ng ulan, nagsisimulang mawalan ng pag-asa ang munting matapang na punla...

records.source: ...But what's this...? The sapling feels a tingling on the top of his head...
records.translation: ...Pero ano ito...? May nakakakiliting pakiramdam ang punla sa tuktok ng ulo nito...

records.source: Perhaps a little rain was what it needed to begin its journey into becoming a tree!
records.translation: Marahil kaunting ulan lang pala ang kailangan nito upang simulan ang paglalakbay tungo sa pagiging isang puno!

records.source: Farewell, little buddy!
records.translation: Paalam, munting kaibigan!

records.source: Mysterium
records.translation: Misteryum

records.source: Peer behind the midnight veil... You must experience to believe!
records.translation: Sumilip sa likod ng tabing ng hatinggabi... Kailangan mo itong maranasan para maniwala!

records.source: 'Mysterium'
records.translation: “Misteryum”

records.source: A faint silhouette in the dark...
records.translation: Isang bahagyang anino sa dilim...

records.source: The desolate, unknown void of space... where untold horrors await.
records.translation: Ang mapanglaw at di-kilalang kawalan ng kalawakan... kung saan naghihintay ang di-mabilang na kakila-kilabot na bagay.

records.source: A variety of disjointed, other-worldly scenes play out...
records.translation: Ipinakikita ang sari-saring putol-putol na tagpong tila mula sa ibang daigdig...

records.source: 'You MUST tell your friends to see MYSTERIUM tonight...'
records.translation: “DAPAT mong sabihin sa mga kaibigan mo na panoorin ang MISTERYUM ngayong gabi...”

records.source: '...Or I will visit you in your sleep!'
records.translation: “...Kung hindi, dadalawin kita habang natutulog ka!”

records.source: Journey Of The Prairie King: The Motion Picture
records.translation: Paglalakbay ng Hari ng Kapatagan: Ang Pelikula

records.source: The beloved video game comes to the silver screen!
records.translation: Mapapanood na sa malaking tabing ang minamahal na video game!

records.source: 'Journey Of The Prairie King: The Motion Picture'
records.translation: “Paglalakbay ng Hari ng Kapatagan: Ang Pelikula”

records.source: On the dusty old trail once again, we find Prairie King watching over a wagon train full of valuable treasure.
records.translation: Muli sa lumang maalikabok na landas, makikita natin ang Hari ng Kapatagan na nagbabantay sa isang karaban ng mga bagon na puno ng mahalagang kayamanan.
